question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The tribals of India are ______still a neglected lot.
solution:
The correct answer is **'by and large'**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given phrases and their usage - 
 
 
• **by and large - **on the whole; everything considered.** **

 
 
• **​***Example - Mammals have, **by and large**, bigger brains than reptiles.**​*
 
 
 
• over and above - in addition to.
 
 
• ​*Example - The hotel had *e*xceptional service **over and above **what normally might be expected.*
 
 
 
• all in all - on the whole. 
 
 
• ​*Example - **All in all** it's been a good year.*
 
 
 
• by and by - before long; eventually.
 
 
• ​*Example - I'll get to Ireland **by and by**; I've wanted to go for a while.*
 
 
 
 
 
• The sentence with the blank implies that the Indian tribals are a neglected lot. The blank needs a phrase that would indicate how this comprises most of them. 
 
• Thus, **by and ****large **is the best fit phrase for the given blank. 
 
• This makes **option 1 **the correct answer. 

​***Correct sentence - ****The tribals of India are **by and large **still a neglected lot.*
